CASE safe_core
deepgram (deepgram): PASS
  warning: Deepgram driver must range-check inactivity durations
  warning: Deepgram driver must verify a max-duration cap
  warning: Deepgram drops interruption ignore phrases
  warning: Deepgram integrates turn detection into listen; placement is ignored
  warning: Deepgram interruption minimum words is lossy
  warning: Deepgram semantic endpointing depends on the bound listen model
  warning: declares a route no target names, so nothing uses it: connections/primary_phone.yaml, connections/twilio_sip.yaml
